summary: Play back a computed flow field as data with provenance, and refuse to let the viewer treat playback as live simulation.
objective: Build a supplied-field viewer with provenance, slices, streamline integration and probes, distinguishing those visualization computations from a new CFD solve.
intent_signals: Show a precomputed flow field with slices and probes.
Play back CFD results without implying the scene is solving them.
example_prompts: Build a flow field playback viewer with a slice plane, seeded streamlines and a metadata panel.
Show a benchmark flow case with its conditions and grid stated on screen.
negative_signals: Not a solver: nothing in this scene computes a flow, and changing a displayed parameter cannot change the data.
Not a validation of any solver or turbulence model.
not_for: Not a solver: nothing in this scene computes a flow, and changing a displayed parameter cannot change the data.
Not a validation of any solver or turbulence model.

entities.name: Dataset frames
entities.guidance: Treat the field as a sequence of frames on a declared grid, with the grid and time step shown, since interpolation between frames is a display choice.

entities.name: Slice and probe
entities.guidance: Provide a slice plane and a point probe that report interpolated values with the interpolation scheme named.

entities.name: Provenance panel
entities.guidance: State the case, the boundary conditions, the solver and version that produced the data, and the licence of the dataset.

state_contract.model: Frames of a vector or scalar field on a stated grid, a playback index, and derived slices, instantaneous streamlines and probe readouts. Derived quantities name their interpolation/integration; these are computations on supplied data, not new CFD solutions.
state_contract.authority: The loaded dataset is authoritative. No control in the scene may alter the field values; controls change only what is displayed.
actions: Scrub or step the playback index.
Move the slice plane and the probe.
Reset the view and reload the dataset.

invariants: No interaction changes stored field values; controls change only what is displayed. Interpolation, slicing and streamline integration are computations performed on that data, but none of them is a new flow solution.
Streamlines are integrated within one frame and are labelled as instantaneous streamlines, not particle paths, unless the dataset is steady.
Probe values state the interpolation scheme and the grid cell they came from.
Seeds outside the domain or inside a masked region are rejected, and a streamline stops at a domain exit or where the field is zero rather than being extended by extrapolation.
motion_guidance: Play frames at a stated rate with the physical time per frame shown, so playback speed is never mistaken for flow speed.
Allow pausing at any frame; a field that can only be watched cannot be inspected.
known_limits: Playback fidelity depends on the dataset resolution and its own numerical error, and also on the reconstruction, sampling and colour mapping chosen here; none of these is assessed by the scene.
No dataset is bundled with this recipe: the user supplies data and its licence.
Authored guidance only: no scene runtime, rendering or numerical calibration has been run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Public turbulence modelling resources maintained for verification and validation provide documented cases together with reference experimental and high-fidelity data, which is the kind of provenance a playback scene should cite.
claims.scope: Existence and purpose of such a resource as stated on its landing page; no dataset was retrieved or redistributed here.

source_refs.locator: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource landing page description

object_craft.structure: A bounded domain box with the grid extents visible, so the data limits are part of the object rather than implied.
object_craft.material: Neutral domain wireframe; field colour uses a stated colour map with a legend and units, never an unlabelled gradient.
object_craft.articulation: Frames swap at the playback index; interpolation between frames is optional and labelled.

object_craft.structure: A movable plane with a border and a probe marker with a leader line to its readout.
object_craft.material: Slice uses the same colour map and legend as the volume so values are comparable across views.
object_craft.articulation: Both update continuously while dragging, with the current frame index shown.

physical_contract.scope: Data playback and visualisation only; no fluid equations are solved in the scene.
checks: For the same dataset and the same interpolation settings, probe values agree across sessions within a stated numerical tolerance; no identical result is promised across different libraries or platforms.
Every displayed field has a legend with units and a named colour map.
